name: Ray of Sunshine
source:
Ray (he/they) is a kind and thorough human. After being diagnosed with a severe Vitamin D deficiency and an unfortunate mistake, Ray finds himself working at an occult spot. Is he a step closer to love, and will he find a way to shine on his own? 

[From [url=https://tamikanisushi.itch.io/ray-of-sunshine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雷（他/他们）是一个善良而彻底的人。雷被诊断出严重缺乏维生素D并犯了一个不幸的错误后，发现自己在一个神秘的地方工作。他是否离爱情又近了一步，又能否找到让自己发光发热的道路呢？

[来自[url=https://tamikanisushi.itch.io/ray-of-sunshine]itch.io[/url]]
